messages.author: Tunde Oyelowo
messages.text: Lot 9340-A had the March event too — the 2026-05 bulletin does not cover a second event. 9340-B is covered and clean.

messages.author: Célia Baptiste
messages.text: Line 2 is three stations now, not the two on the old layout sheet. The short-series jig uses the S gauge family and its own lot.

messages.author: Sören Lindqvist
messages.text: An expedited build would be mine to approve; nobody has asked.
